body:
Quick mode — no voting panel. Rounds 1: 6 Cursor specialists in parallel + generic Codex. Main agent reviewed findings across 1 round.

Accepted: 1 (branch-scoped title derivation to avoid fallthrough to main commits)
Rejected: 8 (out-of-scope, pre-existing artifacts, bump/CHANGELOG concerns)

## Rejected Code Review Findings
(see rejected-findings.md)
### [Code Review] Cursor-Structure (round 1)
**Finding**: CHANGELOG.md:44-48 does not mention the ship-pr PR title fix in the 27.6.4 section.
**Reason not implemented**: The version bump step (bump-version skill) owns CHANGELOG entries; manually adding one here would conflict with the automated bump process.

### [Code Review] Cursor-Structure (round 1)
**Finding**: larch-logs/implement/BFE13F40 run tree from /Users/zhupanov/larch2 bundled in branch.
**Reason not implemented**: Pre-existing larch-log artifact from a prior session flushed before my commits; not introduced by this PR. Out of scope.

### [Code Review] Cursor-Structure (round 1)
**Finding**: Committed manifest has status=in-progress (larch-logs/implement/57EE0CA9).
**Reason not implemented**: Expected — the manifest status is updated to `done` at Step 18 teardown. In-progress during the run is correct.

### [Code Review] Cursor-Structure (round 1)
**Finding**: tally-votes.sh:55-74 — accept-all loop duplicated for BOTH_DOWN and <2 voters.
**Reason not implemented**: Pre-existing pattern in tally-votes.sh, unrelated to the ship-pr title fix. Out of scope.

### [Code Review] Cursor-Correctness (round 1)
**Finding**: CHANGELOG.md:48 cites voting-protocol.md rows 15-16 but threshold rules are at lines 54-63.
**Reason not implemented**: This refers to changes in tally-votes.sh and CHANGELOG that are not part of this PR. Out of scope.

### [Code Review] Cursor-Security (round 1)
**Finding**: Committed manifest fields expose absolute operator filesystem paths (operator_cwd, operator_repo_root).
**Reason not implemented**: Pre-existing larch-log behavior, not introduced by this PR. The sanitization of these fields is a separate concern.

### [Code Review] Cursor-Security (round 1)
**Finding**: tally-votes.sh:67-74 — insufficient voter files trigger accept-all findings after a warning.
**Reason not implemented**: Pre-existing behavior in tally-votes.sh, unrelated to ship-pr title fix. Out of scope.

### [Code Review] Cursor-Correctness (round 1)
**Finding**: The embedded plan in larch-logs only lists ship-pr files, but the branch includes tally-votes and CHANGELOG changes.
**Reason not implemented**: The plan I wrote correctly covers the scope of my changes (ship-pr.sh and ship-pr.md only). The tally-votes and CHANGELOG changes are pre-existing in the branch from prior sessions.
